target_body.interpretation: Assumed target settings; not a measurement of the filmed climber.

mediapipe.interpretation: Target-verified observation coverage; display-only estimates are excluded.

rtmw.interpretation: Finite raw poses are not necessarily visible observations; the identity guard excludes uncertain frames.

hold_map.selection: Current manual selection from Section 4B; order is not a movement sequence
hold_map.method: Observed-pixel reconstruction, cap 400, whole-image and six 768-pixel overlapping tiles, mask-overlap deduplication
hold_map.limitation: Development point audit is not complete wall recall, mask AP or contact accuracy.

alignment.interpretation: Passing global homography checks does not validate every wall plane.

automatic_contacts.interpretation: No trial2 ground-truth labels; confidence coverage is not accuracy or human time saved.
automatic_contacts.comparison_warning: Route selection changes the candidate space. Confidence coverage is not measured contact accuracy.

reasons: Overhang and multiple wall planes require geometry review
No confirmed endpoint identities, release/arrival or three continuous supports
Automatic unreviewed IK remains disabled in the deployed model

fixes: Allow the existing wall_contact model class in the review loader
Use one configurable reference index for hold detection, alignment, prediction and IK
Reject mixed reference maps, alignment caches and predictions
Keep legacy reference-zero caches compatible; disable the original scale on other references
Reconstruct masked wall pixels from observed donor frames
Raise the detector cap and add tiled inference with mask deduplication
Exclude explicit non-hold candidates and withhold an uncertain object
Validate reconstruction video/cache identity and preserve pixel provenance

tests.trial1_motion_artifacts: Six artifacts and original automatic-contact cache remain valid

preservation.trial1_motion_summary: Refreshed code provenance; unchanged 23-frame fit and contact errors

hold_evaluation.scope: Assistant-reviewed development sample, with one-to-one 3-pixel-tolerance mask matches; the audit sample differs from the subsequent user-confirmed route

raw_candidate_spot_check.interpretation: Raw automatic-candidate spot check, not whole-wall segmentation AP. Do not report a post-cleanup precision estimate on this same reviewed sample.

route_selection_comparison.limitation: No trial2 frame-level contact ground truth; no measured accuracy comparison.
route_selection_comparison.comparison_scope: Earlier route selection predates identity correction; current results also include corrected pose alignment and an identity observation guard.

identity_tracking.interpretation: Development-case diagnostics, including interpolation; not an independent pose or identity benchmark.
